column1: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE NATIONAL COUNCIL

column2: FOR DISASTER MANAGEMENT;  THE  DISASTER MANAGEMENT
CENTRE; THE APPOINTMENT OF TECHNICAL ADVISORY COMMITTEES;
THE    PREPARATION  OF  DISASTER  MANAGEMENT  PLANS;  THE
DECLARATION OF A STATE OF DISASTER; THE AWARD  OF  COMPENSATION
AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.

column1: WHEREAS  human  life,  property  and  the  environment  of
Sri Lanka  is being threatened and endangered due to certain
disasters taking place within the  territory of Sri Lanka:
AND WHEREAS it has become necessary to protect human
life and property of the people and the environment of Sri
Lanka from the consequence of these disasters, by effectively
dealing  with  them  from  a  national  perspective  by    the
preparation  of  a  national  policy  and  a  plan  and  by  the
appointment  of  centrally  co-ordinated    committees  and
institutions to give effect to such policy and plan :
NOW THEREFORE be it enacted by the Parliament of the
Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

column2: This Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Sri  Lanka  Disaster

column1: Management Act,  No.  13  of  2005,  and  shall  come  into
operation  on  such  date  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the
“appointed  date”)  as  the  Minister  may  appoint  by  Order
published in the Gazette.

column2: (1) There  shall  be  established  a  body  called  the

column1: National  Council  for  Disaster  Management  (hereinafter  in
this Act referred to as the “Council”).

column2: (2) The Council shall by the name assigned to it by

column1: subsection (1), be a body corporate and shall have perpetual
succession and a common seal and may sue and be sued in
such name.
